raw.chosen: Mark resumable bootstrap outcomes explicitly so fatal once failures remain non-retryable
raw.reasoning: The process exit and scoped sibling policy must distinguish bounded checkpoint/cancellation outcomes from provider, configuration, and cycle failures even when errors are wrapped or joined. An explicit marker plus an all-branches predicate preserves diagnostic wrapping while keeping fatal and mixed aggregates at exit 1.

This trajectory contains no captured command/output evidence.

retrospective.summary: Repaired PR #477 once-mode classification: explicit resumable bootstrap markers now yield EX_TEMPFAIL only for all-resumable error trees; provider/cycle/config failures and mixed joins remain exit 1, and scoped siblings cancel on mixed fatal outcomes.
